provenance: AI-written supplementary eval (Claude), not an independent human-written blind set. Eval was already seen in v1 and is no longer unseen data. V2 configuration and threshold use validation only; final v2 eval is scored once after freezing.

thresholdPolicy.reason: Highest coverage among nonempty fixed 0.00-0.95 (step 0.05) thresholds with accepted accuracy >=90%; tie chooses lower threshold. No additional minimum-support restriction; report accepted count explicitly.
